title: Every odd antihole is strongly chromatic-choosable: paper, Lean 4 proof and checking programs
description:
Final revision of the paper, single column, 11 pages, with its LaTeX source, a Lean 4 proof of the main theorem with Mathlib, and programs that check it on the smallest antiholes. The paper proves Conjecture 9 of A. Fiujlaali and J. McDonald, Restricting odd antiholes in critical graphs via list coloring (arXiv:2610.14241): for every l at least 3 the odd antihole on 2l-1 vertices is strongly l-chromatic-choosable, that is, its chromatic number is l and every assignment of lists of size l-1 from which it cannot be coloured gives all vertices the same list. It deduces their Conjecture 3: an odd-hole-free k-critical graph of maximum degree D containing an odd antihole with 2(D-k)+7 vertices is that antihole. Every statement is proved by hand; no statement rests on the programs.

The results were first made public on 15 October 2026 as release v1.0.0 of this repository (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23393860). An earlier and incomplete version of the paper appeared on Hexagon as hexagon:2610.00319.
